Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: Yes, go ahead and note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.
Q: Understood. Can you walk me through where and when the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot near a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking spcae in the row near
the main entrance, and I was going very slowly, maybe five miles an hour.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?
A: Not right away. I had checked my mirror, but a white sedan came down the lane from my right side pretty quickly. I
braked, but we still made contact on my front passenger corner.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my left hand out on the steering wheel when I stopped, and I felt a sharp pain in my wrist. I went to
urgent care later that afternoon and they took X-rays. The doctor told me it's a fracture, and I've got a splint and I'm
supposed to see a hand specialist.
Q: Did you call for medical assistance at the scene?
A: No, I didn't think it was serious at first. I was shaken up but I could still drive, so I drove myself home and got it
checked later.
Q: Did anyone else witness the collision?
A: I didn't see anyone standing nearby. There may have been people inside the store, but I can't say for sure.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?
A: Just that I have photos of both vehicles on my phone, and I can send them to you. I'd like to get this resolved so I
can get back to work.
Q: We'll follow up on that. Thank you for your time today.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
